name: Park Jae-hyun
bio:
Park Jae-hyun's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. While studying mechanical engineering at KAIST, he volunteered at a local go-kart track, quickly becoming fascinated by the intricacies of chassis design and the constant need for improvement. After graduation, he honed his fabrication skills at a specialized automotive workshop before being recruited by a junior formula team looking to expand their technical capabilities. His dedication and precision soon caught the eye of Joe Gibbs Racing scouts, leading to his current role.

As a fabricator, Jae-hyun approaches every task with a meticulous eye, believing that even the smallest detail can significantly impact performance. He thrives on the challenge of translating engineering designs into tangible components, often collaborating with engineers to optimize parts for both strength and weight. His loyalty to the team and his unwavering commitment to excellence make him a highly valued member of the JGR crew. He is known for his ability to work quickly and accurately, even under pressure, and his quiet demeanor belies a sharp mind always searching for innovative solutions.

physical.description: Jae-hyun has a lean build and a focused gaze, often seen with a slight smudge of grease on his cheek.
